name: Lamb The
overview: The Scriptures present the lamb as a significant symbol in covenant relationships, exemplified in Genesis 21 where Abraham sets apart seven ewe lambs as a witness to the well he had dug. This act highlights the lamb's role in confirming agreements and bearing testimony, reflecting its value and sacred function among God's people. Through this passage, the lamb emerges not merely as livestock but as a cherished and meaningful element in divine-human interaction.
